subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw support a global administrative auth refresh, and if so, which sessions and persisted overrides may it affect while runs are active?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing capability, but code alone cannot decide the intended authorization scope, explicit-pin precedence, or whether active runs should finish, cancel, or retry across a credential transition.

options.title: Add scoped auth refresh
options.body: Introduce an additive admin-only refresh operation with explicit agent/session scope, preserved context, override precedence, and defined active-run semantics.

options.title: Refresh only on new runs
options.body: Keep session state intact but reload credentials only when each session begins its next idle run, avoiding a global immediate transition.

options.title: Keep manual session control
options.body: Retain keyed reset and per-session override commands rather than adding a cross-session administrative operation.

recommendation.title: Add scoped auth refresh
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive admin-only refresh operation with explicit agent/session scope, preserved context, override precedence, and defined active-run semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and issue-discussion signals connect this person to the affected Gateway and session reset decision surface.
